gap: No result ChatGPT got states that EcoFlow's STREAM Ultra, the only battery balcony kit EcoFlow markets in the US, starts its inverter only after it detects a valid grid signal, and that its two outlets give 800 W from a single unit with appliances limited to surges below 1,200 W.
standout_why: SolutionEnergy's with-battery page (cited) covers anti-islanding in general terms. It says STREAM 'stops feeding the grid and you can plug appliances into its outlets', but it gives no outlet wattage or surge limit and doesn't mention the grid-signal start condition. balconysolarkits.us (cited) gives the 800 W / 1,200 W grid figures and UL1741/IEEE1547. It says nothing about outlets, outage behavior or anti-islanding. Our own Dealectric page has 'immediately ceases grid-tied output', says outage power goes only to its two outlets, and covers the Utah-only H.B. 340 rule. It lacks the surge cap below 1,200 W, the 'only initiates inverter output after detecting a valid grid signal' wording and the 'Must be connected to household AC circuits while the grid is active' condition. None of these pages has Solar United Neighbors' 160 ms export-stop figure or its statement that no plug-in system has whole-system UL/NRTL certification. I could not read the Wattbalcon page (TLS certificate error) or the Zendure US page (HTTP 429), so neither was compared.
decides: This supports picking a portable power station kit with its own panel, such as the BLUETTI AC180 + 2× 200 W, ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 or Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + panel, for a US shopper who wants a battery to run things at night or in an outage. EcoFlow's battery-integrated balcony unit works as a grid-dependent bill-saver. EcoFlow sells it for plug-and-play only in Utah. In an outage, its two outlets give 800 W from a single unit and won't take appliances that surge to 1,200 W or more, so a microwave or a heater may not run. The STREAM Ultra only makes sense for a Utah shopper whose goal is cutting the bill, not backup power.
candidates: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + solar panel kit
BLUETTI AC180 + 2× 200 W Solar Panel Kit
ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W Solar Generator Kit

findings.label: Inverter start condition
findings.value: Inverter output starts only after the unit detects a valid grid signal
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: EcoFlow US page, verbatim: 'It only initiates inverter output after detecting a valid grid signal,' and 'The system features built-in anti-islanding protection to ensure safe grid integration.'

findings.label: Behavior when the grid fails
findings.value: Grid-tied output stops immediately; outage power goes only to essential appliances plugged into the unit
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Verbatim: 'In the event of a power outage or abnormal grid disconnection, the system immediately ceases grid-tied output,' and 'In an outage, backup power is reserved solely for essential appliances.'

findings.label: Outlet output and surge limit
findings.value: 2 AC outlets; 800 W from a single unit (1,200 W with STREAM Microinverter); connected appliances must surge below 1,200 W
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Dual AC outlets allow simultaneous powering of two appliances, providing up to 800W output from a single unit or up to 1,200W when paired with the STREAM Microinverter' and 'Appliances connected directly to the Ultra must have a surge power below 1,200W during operation.' The page does not say whether the 800 W figure also holds on battery with the grid down.

findings.label: Grid-connection requirement
findings.value: Must be connected to household AC circuits while the grid is active
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Verbatim wording on the EcoFlow US page.

findings.label: Where EcoFlow sells it in the US
findings.value: Sale and plug-and-play installation in Utah only (H.B. 340)
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Footnote 6: 'Due to restrictions under the H.B. 340 Solar Power Amendments, this product is only available for sale and plug-and-play installation in Utah.'

findings.label: Certifications claimed
findings.value: UL 1741 and IEEE 1547; no UL 3700 or UL 9540 claim on the page
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Verbatim: 'UL1741-Certified & IEEE1547-Certified'. UL 3700 and UL 9540 do not appear on the page.

findings.label: Required export-stop time in an outage
findings.source_title: Plug-in solar consumer guide - Solar United Neighbors
findings.note: Solar United Neighbors FAQ: 'When a power outage is detected, the system must automatically stop exporting electricity within 160 milliseconds.' The guide says UL 3700 requires UL 1741 and IEEE 1547 compliance.

findings.label: UL 3700 whole-system certification status
findings.value: No US plug-in system holds a whole-system UL/NRTL certification; a few components (Hoymiles and APsystems EZ1 inverters) hold UL 3700 subassembly certification from CSA Group
findings.source_title: Plug-in solar consumer guide - Solar United Neighbors
findings.note: Solar United Neighbors: 'no plug-in systems in the U.S. have received a certification from UL or NRTL'; 'as of late November 2026, we are only aware of a few plug-in system components that are certified under UL 3700.' The guide dates UL's release of UL 3700 criteria to December 11, 2025. Our page says January 8, 2026 (launch), so check which event each date refers to.

findings.label: Branch-circuit overload masking
findings.value: Plug-in generation can hide overloaded wiring from the breaker; larger systems may need a dedicated circuit
findings.source_title: Plug-in solar consumer guide - Solar United Neighbors
findings.note: Verbatim: 'The addition of generation can mask or hide the overloaded wiring so the breaker box does not trip the circuit off. This is why larger plug-in systems may require a dedicated electric circuit.'
